taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: React Native JavaScript-to-native module capability boundaries
controls.source_trace: Determine whether lower-trust JS/content can reach privileged native methods and choose resources/actions beyond its authorized feature.
controls.implementation_branch: Define whether JavaScript is trusted bundled code or lower-trust remotely supplied content. A native method exposed to the trusted application runtime is not automatically a web-origin bridge. Trace the actual entry from WebView/messages/updates into module arguments, native permissions and object checks before claiming another origin can invoke it.
controls.operational_method: Resolve legacy bridge versus New Architecture/TurboModule registration, the actual exported native method and per-platform argument conversion. Find the lower-trust entry into that method before treating bundled application JS as an attacker. Compare a legitimate native invocation with a malformed/foreign-resource value at the real conversion boundary using an owned app fixture; a generic mock bridge cannot prove installed module exposure.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned app fixture with an inert native operation and synthetic JS input; compare intended calls and a forbidden resource selection.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A powerful native module exposed to fully trusted application JS is not itself a defect; establish a lower-trust caller path.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Constrain module arguments and capabilities at the native boundary and retest intended application use.
